themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, automate workflows, and assist in complex decision-making processes.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that aid developers in writing, understanding, and optimizing code, including code generation and analysis.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered tools designed to enhance and automate various aspects of the research process, from data collection to insight generation.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Explores how AI is applied to product development, roadmapping, feature prioritization, and understanding user needs within the product lifecycle.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Investigates the creation and use of AI-generated personas or data that mimic real users for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Details the application of AI to condense large amounts of text, research findings, or user feedback into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in augmenting the creative and analytical processes within user experience design and research.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Examines AI's contribution to automating, enhancing, and analyzing usability testing processes and feedback.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Discusses the methods and considerations for assessing the effectiveness, reliability, and suitability of various AI tools.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Addresses the ways AI is changing job roles, skill requirements, and the overall structure of the workforce.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
